messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}When I get into something,{01 00 00 05 00} I
don't do it halfway.{01 00 00 05 00} Nope! I
dive right in!
{07 14 00}Like recently, I completed
a series of furniture I was
collecting.
{07 19 00}The{ff 00 00 02} Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}even gave me{ff 00 00 02} {04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}points.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 00 00}It was pretty cool!

{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Let me give you some tips
on getting in good with the
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}First,{01 00 00 0a 00} collect the basics
for living. {01 00 00 0a 00}You know what
I'm talking about.
{07 14 00}I earned {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points
that way!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}And the rest was
history!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Annan sulle paar nõuannet,
kuidas {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemiaga{ff 00 00 00} läbi saada.
{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Esiteks,{01 00 00 0a 00} kogu eluks
vajalikud põhiasjad. {01 00 00 0a 00}Tead
küll, millest ma räägin.
{07 14 00}Teenisin {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti
nii!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 03 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ja ülejäänu on
ajalugu!

messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}You know,{01 00 00 0a 00} the{ff 00 00 02} Happy Room
Academy{ff 00 00 00} is simpler to
navigate than you'd think.
{07 00 00}I just followed what this TV
show about {ff 00 00 02}feng shui {ff 00 00 00}told
me to do.
{07 14 00}And I earned a whopping
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points! {01 00 00 0a 00}Yup,
it was pretty thrilling.
{07 19 00}Though I wonder if the {ff 00 00 02}HRA{ff 00 00 00}
was responsible for that
show in the first place.{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Tead,{01 00 00 0a 00} {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemias{ff 00 00 00} on lihtsam
orienteeruda, kui arvad.
{07 00 00}Ma lihtsalt tegin nii, nagu
üks {ff 00 00 02}fengshui {ff 00 00 00}telesaade
käskis.
{07 14 00}Ja teenisin tervelt
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti! {01 00 00 0a 00}Jah,
see oli päris põnev.
{07 19 00}Kuigi huvitav, kas {ff 00 00 02}KKA{ff 00 00 00}
korraldaski selle saate
üldse.{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Yes, I pay attention to what{01 00 00 0a 00}
the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}says about my house.
{07 19 00}That's why I've tried to
maintain the same feel with
each piece in my house.
{07 14 00}The result? {01 00 00 0a 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}points!{01 00 00 14 00} Not bad, huh?
{01 00 00 0a 00}In fact, it's pretty great!
messages.et:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Jah, ma panen tähele, mida{01 00 00 0a 00}
{ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu Akadeemia
{ff 00 00 00}mu maja kohta ütleb.
{07 19 00}Sellepärast olen üritanud
hoida iga esemega majas
sama tunnet.
{07 14 00}Tulemus? {01 00 00 0a 00}{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}punkti!{01 00 00 14 00} Pole paha, mis?
{01 00 00 0a 00}Tegelikult päris hea!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}The{ff 00 00 02} Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}kinda weirds me out.

{07 16 00}Doesn't entering people's
houses when they're not
there{01 00 00 05 00} seem kind of illegal?!
{07 14 00}Oh, well.{01 00 00 0a 00} At least they gave
me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points. {01 00 00 0a 00}Well,
they didn't just GIVE them.
{07 19 00}I had to earn them by
artfully arranging each
piece, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}{ff 00 00 02} Kauni Kodu Akadeemia
{ff 00 00 00}ajab mind pisut segadusse.

{07 16 00}Kas inimeste majja minek,
kui neid pole kodus,{01 00 00 05 00}
ei tundu ebaseaduslik?!
{07 14 00}Noh.{01 00 00 0a 00} Vähemalt andsid nad
mulle {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti. {01 00 00 0a 00}Aga
nad ei ANDNUD neid muidu.
{07 19 00}Pidin need teenima, seades
iga eseme kunstipäraselt,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I left my stuff everywhere
and didn't organize my
space at all.
{07 15 00}So the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}only gave me a measly
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}points{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Lame!
{07 05 00}Sheesh!{01 00 00 0f 00} What gives them the
right to evaluate MY
house, anyway! {01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma jätsin oma asjad igale
poole ega korrastanud
ruumi üldse.
{07 15 00}Nii et {ff 00 00 02}Kauni Kodu
Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00} andis ainult
{ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}punkti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Nõme!
{07 05 00}Ptüi!{01 00 00 0f 00} Mis õigus neil on
hinnata MINU maja!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
